terms.en: Existence: there is and there are

en.title: Existence: there is and there are
en.summary: To say that something exists, English uses there is for one thing and there are for more than one.

paragraphs: To say that something exists or is present, English uses there is for one thing and there are for more than one. This is the way to introduce new things in a place, such as a room, a town or a story. In many languages one verb such as have or be does this job.

There is a dummy subject, and the real subject comes after the verb. The verb agrees with the real subject, so we say there is a book, but there are books. In speech people often say there's for both singular and plural. For questions put is or are before there. For negatives add not or no.

blocks.html:
FormExample
singularThere is a bus at nine.
pluralThere are three buses.
negativeThere isn't a bank here.
questionIs there a bank here?
pastThere was a problem.

paragraphs: There is a book on the table introduces a new thing. It is on the table says where a known thing is. We say There is a cat in the garden, and then The cat is black. The article changes from a to the.
We often use there with quantifiers: There are many people, There isn't any milk, There is no time. In the negative, any and no both work, but any follows not and no stands alone.

items: Wrong: **Have a bank near here.** Right: **There is a bank near here.**
Wrong: **There is two chairs.** Right: **There are two chairs.**
Wrong: **It has a café in the street.** Right: **There is a café in the street.**

ro.title: Existența: „este” și „sunt”
ro.summary: În limba română, folosim formele verbului „a fi”, „este” și „sunt”, pentru a arăta existența unui lucru.

paragraphs: Pentru a spune că un lucru există, folosim verbul „a fi”. Pentru un singur obiect, folosim „este” sau forma scurtă „e”. Pentru mai multe obiecte, folosim forma „sunt”.
Verbul se schimbă după numărul lucrurilor care există. La singular folosim „este” sau forma scurtă „e”. La plural folosim forma „sunt”. În vorbirea curentă, forma „e” este foarte des folosită.

blocks.html:
NumărFormăExemplu
Singulareste / eAici este un magazin mic.
Singular (vorbire curentă)eE o problemă mare aici.
PluralsuntAcolo sunt trei mașini noi.
Întrebare (singular)este / eEste un spital în oraș?
Întrebare (plural)suntSunt camere libere la hotel?
